name: Clockwork koi
notes: Origin at the body centre, nose +Z, up +Y, 14 m long. Joints swim -1...1 (S-wave through four tail segments, 6/10/14/18 deg, positive toward +X), fins 0...1 (pectorals out 45 deg, dorsal up 35 deg), jaw 0...1 (lower jaw 28 deg), glow 0...1 are empty drivers; child parts mimic them. Follower lamps switches option at glow 0.05 (eye irises and gill slits emissive amber, two amber point lights).
parts: lofted kohaku enamel body, 64 stations by 64 radial points, white with red panels and head spot
overlapping brass and copper scale plates on the flanks
gear ring with 28 brass teeth at the gill line
glass eye domes over amber irises with black pupils, brass barbels
hinged lower jaw with dark mouth lining
four chained tail segments and a forked caudal fin
perforated metal fin membranes on brass spines: pectorals, dorsal, pelvics, anal
style: Brass and copper clockwork koi: glossy baked enamel red and white body, polished metal scale plates, brass gears, perforated metal fins, glowing amber eyes. Original design.
summary: 14 m clockwork koi: lofted kohaku enamel body, brass and copper scale plates, gill gear ring, glass eyes with amber irises, jaw, segmented tail, mesh fins.
